description: This file defines classes and functions related to managing SSH password data and commands within the Kickstart configuration system, including data structures for SSH password info, command parsing, and handling different versions.

classes.name: F13_SshPwData
classes.description: Data class representing SSH password information for Red Hat's Kickstart system, including username, password, encryption status, and lock status.

classes.name: F24_SshPwData
classes.description: Extended data class for SSH password info, adding support for SSH keys, inheriting from F13_SshPwData.

classes.name: F13_SshPw
classes.description: Command class for managing SSH password entries in Kickstart, including parsing, string representation, and version-specific options.

classes.name: F24_SshPw
classes.description: Version-specific subclass of F13_SshPw with additional argument for SSH keys.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes data classes with provided attributes such as username, password, encryption, and SSH key.

methods.name: __str__
methods.description: Returns string representation of the data object, including command-line arguments.

methods.name: _getArgsAsStr
methods.description: Generates command-line argument string based on object attributes.

methods.name: _getParser
methods.description: Creates and configures the command-line argument parser for the sshpw command.

methods.name: parse
methods.description: Parses command-line arguments to create and return a data object, with validation.

methods.name: dataList
methods.description: Returns the list of SSH user data objects managed by the command.

methods.name: dataClass
methods.description: Property that returns the class used for SSH password data objects.
